title: Display discriminative eigenvalue proportions
description: You turn nonnegative eigenvalues into component proportions.

steps.description: You replace negative evals entries with zero. lam therefore contains only nonnegative values.

steps.question: What happens when the sum of lam is zero?
steps.answer: The conditional expression keeps lam as prop. It divides by the sum only when that sum is positive.

steps.description: You plot prop as a bar for each component. The component positions start at one.
You label the chart as discriminative power measured by eigenvalue proportions. The supplied output contains no numeric proportions to compare.
